notes:
Klipr Pro free trials, and a plan re-check while Klipr is running.

Klipr now accepts licence keys from the new Klipr Pro free trial as well as the main product.

It also re-checks your plan every 30 minutes instead of only at startup. If a plan has ended — including a free trial that finished without a payment going through — the bot stops and Klipr tells you why, instead of running on until the next restart. Being offline never stops it: only a definite answer from Gumroad does.
